name: suede-deslop
description: Suede Labs anti-slop pass: strip AI writing patterns from prose before anything goes public. Em dashes, filler openers, manufactured enthusiasm, false agency, passive voice, formulaic structures, all of it. Use when copy, a README, an email, a social post, or a doc is about to ship, after a long AI-assisted writing session, or when text sounds fine but feels generated. NOT FOR: writing new copy (use suede-copy); changing or certifying facts, which must be checked against primary evidence before
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 这是一款清理文本中 AI 写作痕迹的润色工具，适合发布前处理文案、邮件、README 和社交内容，但不负责事实核验。
